evidence: The trapped variable is an incidence-orientation texture: failing columns are R(k!=0) modes, linear in occupancy; each chain holds its own persistent per-cell R texture (rms 0.27-0.33, half-vs-half corr 0.51-0.69) uncorrelated with the other chain (-0.047/-0.007); 55-59% of the chain-difference R energy sits in cells fully born in both chains, only ~20% where the Birth census differs.

Along alternating loops the static target is flat at this point: all Delta, Ud, lambda_J, lambda_R diagonal terms depend only on vertex degrees and the occupied count (operator v003 lines 1540-1556), both preserved; observed 195/195 legal cycle transports accepted (Metropolis rejections 0).

Every present vertex has four ports whose frames are a permutation of +-PROTOTYPES4 (adapter lines 22, 209-210; port_order assigns all four targets), so a uniform choice of occupied ports gives <X_v> = 0 for every degree, so frozen nonzero per-cell R means are exactly what loop randomisation removes.

The present cycle proposal is the bottleneck: 615/748 and 622/783 attempts fail on the reference dwell (617/625 non-alternating), 44/42 empty rosters; only 82/113 legal (11.0%/14.4%), loops <= 8 edges. An occupancy-guided walk is alternating by construction; later-dwell failures were only 7/6 of 748/783.

It also supplies non-contractible loops for free, so no flux-sector restriction (if any) survives; sector-resolved sampling is not indicated because no exactly conserved label can separate chains started from one seed.
